gumroad_title: SEC RIA Database 2026 — 16,551 Registered Investment Adviser Firms (CSV)
gumroad_description:
Complete database of all 16,551 SEC-registered investment adviser (RIA) firms — sourced directly from SEC Form ADV public filings, updated May 2026.

**Same data. 1% of the price.**
Platforms like AdvizorPro and RIA Database charge $5,000–$20,000/year for this exact government-sourced dataset. You get the full flat file for $79, one-time, instant download.

**What's included (61 fields per firm):**
- Firm name, CRD#, SEC registration number
- Main office: address, city, state, ZIP, phone, website
- AUM: discretionary + non-discretionary (USD)
- Employees: total + breakdown by role type
- Clients: total count + 14 client-type categories (HNW individuals, pension plans, corporations, etc.)
- Fee structure: AUM%, hourly, subscription, fixed, performance, other
- Private funds flag + gross assets + hedge/PE/VC counts
- Disclosure/disciplinary history flag + event count
- Registration status + state of incorporation

**Who buys this:**
- Asset managers and ETF sponsors reaching RIA distribution gatekeepers
- Wealthtech SaaS companies (CRM, portfolio management, compliance tools) prospecting for firm clients
- Investment recruiters targeting breakaway advisers
- Boutique M&A advisers tracking the RIA consolidation wave
- Anyone paying $999–$20,000/year for enterprise RIA data platforms

**Format:** CSV, ready for Excel, Google Sheets, or CRM import
**Records:** 16,551 SEC-approved firms (all Approved-status only; non-approved filtered out)
**Source:** SEC IAPD Form ADV bulk data — public domain, no authentication required
**Updated:** May 2026
